# Step 5: QEP Submission

The Quality Enhancement Plan (QEP) is a required component focusing on improving student learning or student success.

## Timeline

**When:** Due T-7 months (6 weeks before On-Site Visit)

## Purpose

The QEP:

- Demonstrates institutional capacity for improvement
- Focuses resources on a specific initiative
- Addresses student learning outcomes and/or student success
- Shows broad-based involvement in planning

## QEP Requirements

::: {.callout-important}
## Key Requirements

- Topic derived from **ongoing planning and assessment**
- **Broad-based support** from campus community
- Focus on **student learning outcomes and/or student success**
- Adequate **resources committed**
- **Assessment plan** with measurable outcomes
- Maximum **75 pages** narrative + **25 pages** appendices
:::

## QEP Development Process

### Topic Selection (T-28 to T-20 months)

1. Review institutional assessment data
2. Identify areas for improvement
3. Engage campus community in discussion
4. Select topic based on institutional priorities
5. Document selection process

### Committee Formation

Form a broad-based QEP Development Committee:

- Faculty representatives (multiple disciplines)
- Student services staff
- Students
- Administrative support
- Assessment expertise

### Document Development (T-20 to T-10 months)

1. Draft student learning outcomes or success metrics
2. Develop implementation plan
3. Create assessment plan
4. Determine resource needs
5. Build timeline
6. Gather stakeholder input
7. Revise based on feedback

## QEP Components

### Required Elements

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Topic | Clear statement of focus area |
| Connection to Planning | How topic emerged from assessment |
| Broad-Based Support | Documentation of involvement |
| Goals and Outcomes | Measurable student learning or success outcomes |
| Literature Review | Foundation in research/best practices |
| Actions to Implement | Specific activities and timeline |
| Resources | Budget, personnel, facilities committed |
| Assessment Plan | How outcomes will be measured |
| Timeline | Implementation schedule |

## Campus Awareness

::: {.callout-tip}
## QEP Awareness Campaign

Before the On-Site Visit, ensure all employees can:

- State the QEP topic
- Explain how it affects their area
- Describe their role (if any)

Committee members will ask anyone about the QEP!
:::

## Submission

### Simultaneous Submissions (T-7 months)

- Quality Enhancement Plan
- Focused Report (if applicable)
- Updated Institutional Summary Form

### Before Submitting

- [ ] Within page limits
- [ ] All required sections included
- [ ] Student outcomes clearly measurable
- [ ] Resources clearly committed
- [ ] Assessment plan complete
- [ ] Broad-based support documented

## Next Step

After submission, proceed to [Step 6: On-Site Visit](6_onsite_visit.qmd).
